requirements.text: Degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong Python programming and software design skills, including with agentic coding tools, with experience delivering maintainable applications or computational workflows.
Experience integrating APIs and implementing typed schemas, automated tests, debugging, and dependency management.
Experience with Git-based development, code review, packaging, and clear technical documentation.
Experience building data pipelines and reliable workflows, including logging, failure recovery, and reproducibility.
Basic fluency in machine learning and data quality, and sufficient chemistry and biology understanding to follow scientific requirements.
Ability to communicate uncertainty and technical concepts clearly to colleagues with different scientific and software backgrounds.
Ability to independently execute defined work, meet agreed milestones, incorporate feedback, and handle internal data securely.
Experience developing LLM applications or agent workflows using the Agents SDK or comparable orchestration frameworks.
Experience with Databricks, cloud platforms, or high-performance computing environments.
Experience with tracing, observability, rate-limit handling, and cost or latency optimization for model APIs.
Experience building evaluation tooling, structured-output validation, or scientific-data applications.
Experience using AI-assisted coding tools with code review and testing or delivering projects in biotechnology or consulting.
Experience with synthetic and/or medicinal chemistry a plus.
